shared_elements: repeated row of similar figures in a row
animal or creature forms in profile
justification: Both surfaces use low relief with profile figures organized into horizontal registers, and both include a row of repeated, near-identical figures across the top; beyond that the content diverges entirely. A shows a naturalistic procession of human bearers in patterned robes carrying bowls and vessels, while B shows schematic animals (a quadruped, a bird with outstretched wing, a crouching creature) with abstract discs and a hatched band, with no human offering-bearers and no held objects.
